title: Pivotality in the tribes function
statement: Let $w,s\in\mathbb N$, let $i$ be a coordinate of the cube of dimension $sw$, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^{sw}$. The tribes function is pivotal at $x$ in coordinate $i$ if and only if every other coordinate in the block containing $i$ equals $-1$, and every block other than the block containing $i$ has at least one coordinate equal to $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: Coordinate i in the cube of dimension sw
